title: Lone pair in a hybrid
hints: Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: O has four hybrids: two form bonds to H and two accommodate lone pairs.
statement:
In the localized $sp^3$ model of water, how many oxygen hybrids contain lone pairs?

[_]{a}

explanations: Two O lone pairs occupy two hybrids.
Lone pairs are part of the local electron geometry.
Water has two O lone pairs.
Two of the four hybrids take part in O–H bonds.
